artists.biography:
Deacon Blue are a Scottish pop band formed in Glasgow during 1985. Their name was taken from the title of the Steely Dan song "Deacon Blues".The current line-up of the band consists of vocalists Ricky Ross and Lorraine McIntosh, keyboard player James Prime and drummer Dougie Vipond.

The band released their debut album, Raintown on 1 May 1987 in the United Kingdom. Their second studio album, When The World Knows Your Name (1989) topped the UK Album Charts for two weeks, and included "Real Gone Kid" which became their first UK top ten single. After releasing further albums in 1991 and 1993, they split up in 1994. Five years later, the band held a reunion gig and this led to a new album, Walking Back Home, with the band now working on a part-time basis; they continue to release new albums, their latest being in September 2012.

perplexity.description:
Riding On The Tide Of Love is a 2021 album by Scottish rock band Deacon Blue, released on the Ear Music label. It serves as a companion piece to their earlier 2020 album City of Love, featuring eight new tracks that were largely recorded during the COVID-19 lockdown. The album continues the band's exploration of melodic rock with a reflective and intimate tone, blending their signature soulful songwriting with a sense of resilience and connection amid challenging times. Some tracks were initially recorded during the City of Love sessions, while others were completed individually by band members during lockdown, highlighting a collaborative yet isolated creative process.

Positioned as the tenth studio album in Deacon Blue's discography, Riding On The Tide Of Love follows a period of renewed commercial success for the band, who had reestablished themselves with a series of albums since their 2012 reunion. The album reached number 23 on the UK charts, reflecting steady fan support despite the pandemic's impact on touring and promotion. Critically, it was seen as a thoughtful and cohesive extension of City of Love, maintaining the band’s reputation for crafting heartfelt, accessible rock music with a mature perspective.
